title: 伊斯特伯里**克里斯蒂娜·伍德：通胀压力未消，大宗商品价格仍处高位
speaker: Christina Wood

segments.en: I do think that's something that we need to bear in mind.
segments.zh: 我确实认为这是我们需要注意的。

segments.en: Even with oil prices coming off, they're still at fairly elevated levels, and in some markets you've seen subsidies come through to ensure that that hasn't really quite impacted the consumer yet.
segments.zh: 即使油价回落，仍处于相当高的水平，在一些市场，补贴措施出台以确保消费者尚未受到太大影响。

segments.en: So I think that's still a dynamic that we have to bear in mind.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这仍是我们需要关注的动态。

segments.en: It's not just all prices, but with certain commodity prices also, we've seen price inflation there.
segments.zh: 不仅仅是油价，某些大宗商品价格也出现了上涨。

segments.en: Even if things have corrected, these are still at fairly elevated levels.
segments.zh: 即使有所回调，这些价格仍处于相当高的水平。

segments.en: So while the risk has come off a little, there are different dynamics at play that mean that inflation is not something we can ignore.
segments.zh: 因此，尽管风险有所缓解，但不同的动态因素意味着通胀不容忽视。

segments.en: And the other part of that also from a macroeconomic perspective would be people will be looking to wear inflation levels kind of settle as well to guide where we see what sort of takes a view on from a rates perspective.
segments.zh: 从宏观角度看，另一方面，人们将关注通胀水平是否稳定，以指导利率前景的预期。
